scope: apps/web/src/components/ui (#989, map #980). kind registry = shadcn base-nova registry item (upstreamItem names it; status pristine = hash must equal the vendored snapshot in scripts/ui-upstream-snapshots.json, deviated = registered divergence with reason). kind adapter = local composition over registry items or a repo-specific primitive (reason required). hash = sha256 over the comment-stripped, line-normalized file content (scripts/ui-normalize.mjs); comment-only edits do not move it, code edits always do. Scope is exactly this directory — domain-directory skins are ui-debt-gate/ui-drift-gate territory.

INVENTORY.md.reason: Documentation, not a component: the reuse inventory this directory ships (new-track list, old-track frozen list, which-piece-to-use rules), moved here from apps/web/COMPONENTS.md so it sits next to the code it lists. Registered so the gate sees the file; its content is prose, and the machine-readable markers it carries are checked by test/ui-reuse-inventory.test.ts.

alert-dialog-shell.tsx.reason: #425 B1: shared confirm-surface base over Base UI AlertDialog; restores the repo three-path close contract (X/Esc/backdrop) that the stock blocking AlertDialog semantics do not provide. Paper face shared with DialogShell (S width by default, same head/body/split footer). Optional finalFocus forwards the Base UI focus target so memory deletion can return to a surviving row or its stable summary after the refreshed list settles (#3666). The backdrop force-renders so a confirm nested in a route dialog (Project settings delete) keeps its own backdrop close.

badge.tsx.reason: Leading and trailing icon insets: has-data-[icon=inline-start] / inline-end padding is 0.75 spacing (3px) instead of upstream 1.5, so a 12px icon in the 20px pill with its 1px border sits 4px from the start edge, equal to its top and bottom gap.

bubble.tsx.reason: #851 G5 / map #980 oklch-fold contract: upstream tinted variant uses relative-color oklch(from var(--primary) L C h) — runtime-dependent, not foldable to a static token value, raw [oklch red under G5. Rewritten as two-token color-mix(in oklch) washes on the file's own bracket idiom (upstream secondary/muted hovers); per-theme ratios derived from the upstream L targets (base 0.93 light / 0.30 dark, hover 0.88 / 0.35) against measured #988 token L values (card 0.9426/0.2553, primary 0.1706/0.9346): 2%/8% light, 7%/14% dark, |dL| <= 0.005 all four faces. No new token slot minted; zero consumers at registration (#1009 A1 consumes secondary/ghost only).

button.tsx.reason: #411/#425 semantic mapping, zero skin: type=button default (implicit-submit guard, repo-wide ui/button law) + data-variant/data-size pass-through (the observable contract e2e material pins assert). Focus-ring, transition-list and brand-variant deviations retired per #982/#991: official ring form restored, brand semantics live in the token layer. Link targets (a render element carrying href or to) go through useRender instead of the Base UI button primitive, so they keep link semantics and never claim nativeButton or role=button; nativeButton=false would turn them into role=button and break link queries. Owner hover policy: pressed buttons stay flat and color transitions exclude box-shadow. A disabled default button keeps the docs/design/surfaces/settings.md forms action-row look: a pale secondary fill with a dim, readable label instead of an opacity fade, plus the border hairline in dark, where that fill nearly matches the dialog canvas.

checkbox.tsx.reason: #952 tri-state semantic mapping, zero skin: Indicator renders MinusIcon when indeterminate — the upstream mixed state reuses the check glyph, losing the partial-vs-full selection distinction the board filter select-all row relies on (#982: real functional gaps stay, skin goes). Hand-built V2 skin and motion retired per #982/#991; geometry/color = upstream verbatim.

context-menu.tsx.reason: Cut down to the four parts the Coordinator reply's press menu uses (Root, Trigger, Content, Item); same deviations as dropdown-menu.tsx: #733 single z ladder (z-(--z-dialog)), the paper menu face from menu.ts (MENU_SURFACE_CLS, MENU_ITEM_CLS with 44px rows under a coarse pointer) and the dropdown's open/close motion.

dialog-shell.tsx.reason: Paper dialog adapter (docs/design/surfaces/chrome.md dialogs) over the registry dialog item: regular faces compose DialogContent/DialogTitle/DialogDescription/DialogClose and own the Paper skin here so dialog.tsx stays pristine (sheet surface, 16px corners, --dialog-shadow, S/M/L widths via --dialog-w-*, 16px title + 12px sub-line + 28px ghost close, body as the only scroll box with stable scrollbar gutter and disabled browser scroll anchoring, split footer with a left hint). Repo behavior contracts kept as semantic mapping (#193 three-segment cap + dialog-head/body/foot testids, #389 finalFocus, #73 retained-mount open flag, #318 layered dismiss, #68 family close law). viewportRoot and bare modes keep the legacy direct-primitive mechanism (search-panel / new-task-dialog / overlay/route-dialog own their geometry); zIndex/onBackdropClick/backdropClassName serve only those two modes, and bare forwards initialFocus. Exports the shared Paper pieces (DIALOG_* classes, DialogFootRow, dialogWidth) for AlertDialogShell and direct registry Dialog consumers. headerAction puts one quiet header action (memory Delete) left of the close button in regular faces. info puts an InfoTip beside the title for a background sentence that is not visible copy. stacked forces the registry overlay for a regular face opened over another dialog, as AlertDialogShell does, so the dialog underneath is dimmed. Programmatic return focus (including explicit returnFocusTo) prevents scrolling so closing a dialog preserves the underlying view's position.
